g.text: ⚡ UNSPLITHK KEYBOARD — ELECTRICAL SCHEMATIC & WIRE DIAGRAM
Clean Orthogonal Matrix Circuit | 38 Keys Split into Left & Right Halves | Diode Direction: col2row | Controller: SuperMini NRF52840 (nice!nano v2 compatible)
Physical Header Pinout • Exact Silkscreen Markings & ZMK GPIO Mappings
Each of the 38 keys in the matrix is constructed from an identical SPST switch in series with a 1N4148 diode.
ELECTRICAL RULE: Current flows Col (HIGH) ➔ Switch ➔ Diode Anode ➔ Cathode [BAND] ➔ Row (Sense).
All black cathode bands of diodes on the same row are soldered together to form that row wire!
📋 MATRIX & SuperMini NRF52840 PINOUT CONFIRMATION TABLE
POWER & CHARGING: Battery (+) connects to B+ (via switch). Battery (-) connects to B-.
BOOST jumper on back: leave OPEN for <500mAh batteries (100mA charge). Bridge only if battery is >500mAh (300mA charge).
